operators.name: hardswish_forward
semantics: Computes elementwise Hardswish activation: y = x * relu6(x + 3) / 6, where relu6 clamps to [0, 6].
Applies to all elements in the input tensor, preserving shape, dtype (float32), device (cuda), and strides.
Equivalent to torch.nn.functional.hardswish(x) without any in-place modification.
Calls nn.Hardswish (module) on input x: output = x * relu6(x + 3) / 6, shape [16, 512, 64000], dtype float32, device cuda.
Returns the tensor directly; no additional operations.
